snippet.title: [Five Hearts Under One Roof season2 : Winter Trip DLC]  Teaser_EN
snippet.description:
🎬 The Official PV for [Five Hearts Under One Roof Season 2: Winter Trip DLC] is finally out! ❄️

“I’m the landlord! But why am I working like a servant?!”

Worn out by endless cleaning, dishes, and errands, Yuman finally runs away from the boarding house! 🏃💨
Just when he thinks he has finally found freedom, another romance begins with new yet familiar encounters.

What awaits Yuman at the end of his escape?
Freedom, or a brand-new love? 💕

Coming soon to Steam!
Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! ❄️

※ Add it to your wishlist to be among the first to hear the latest release news!
※ Find the link in our profile!

❄️Character Introduction
💉Gyu-ri Bang - Nurse / Only looks at Yuman

Nurse Gyu-ri's bright smile and personality
make her a beloved staff member around the hospital.

But her gaze is set on Yuman only.
She's always the first one to catch the tiniest changes,
and always the first one to naturally approach you during hard times.

Gyu-ri's gaze is set on Yuman today, too.

🩺Suzy Lee - Doctor / Mature and straightforward

Yuman's attending physician after his accident,
she skillfully takes care of Yuman with her calm and collected personality.

But sometimes, the way she talks and acts
makes Yuman's heart skip a beat when she's around...

Does Suzy see Yuman as just another patient, or is there something more?

☕ Yu-jeong Yang - Café part-timer / Coworker crush

Yu-jeong is more comfortable working than resting.
That's why she has her three jobs to fill up the day:
café, CVS, and mart, all done diligently every single day.

Although she always looks cheerful,
actually getting closer to people is still a struggle for her.

But it seems like her world is slowly changing
as she spends more time with Yuman...


And on top of that,
Gran, Min-jung, and Mal-sook also begin setting out to find Yuman! 👀


❄️ A special winter story beyond the boarding house
💙 Relationships and romances taking unexpected turns
🎮 Your choices shape the story and its endings

[Five Hearts Under One Roof Season 2: Winter Trip DLC]
Coming soon! 🏠❄️
